title_original: 울릉도ㆍ흑산도 등 국토외곽 먼섬 지원 특별법 시행령
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 35948, December 30, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That the amendments made under Article 4 of these Addenda to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but not yet in force shall take effect on the respective enforcement dates of those Decrees.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (63) Omitted.

(64) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Support for Remote Islands on the Outskirts of the National Territory Including Ulleungdo and Heuksando shall be amended as follows:

In the main sentence of Article 5, "Minister of Economy and Finance" shall be replaced with "Minister of Planning and Budget".

(65) through (176) Omitted.
